sql: /* mysql-connector-java-5.1.46 ( Revision: 9cc87a48e75c2d2e87c1a293b2862ce651cb256e ) */SELECT  @@session.auto_increment_increment AS auto_increment_increment, @@character_set_client AS character_set_client, @@character_set_connection AS character_set_connection, @@character_set_results AS character_set_results, @@character_set_server AS character_set_server, @@collation_server AS collation_server, @@init_connect AS init_connect, @@interactive_timeout AS interactive_timeout, @@license AS license, @@lower_case_table_names AS lower_case_table_names, @@max_allowed_packet AS max_allowed_packet, @@net_buffer_length AS net_buffer_length, @@net_write_timeout AS net_write_timeout, @@query_cache_size AS query_cache_size, @@query_cache_type AS query_cache_type, @@sql_mode AS sql_mode, @@system_time_zone AS system_time_zone, @@time_zone AS time_zone, @@transaction_isolation AS transaction_isolation, @@wait_timeout AS wait_timeout
SELECT THREAD_ID FROM performance_schema.threads WHERE PROCESSLIST_ID=CONNECTION_ID()

SELECT
  CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.props, '$.archetype.forum_id')) AS SIGNED) AS external_forum_id,
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.props, '$.archetype.title')) AS title,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN memberships.friend_id=author.id THEN p.id END) AS post_count
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT member.src AS forum_id, member.dst AS friend_id
  FROM anchors member
  JOIN (
    SELECT k.dst AS id FROM anchors k
    WHERE k.src='6c0eeb86-bda6-5055-b3cf-81a8bf523191' AND k.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND k.arch_type='Knows'
      AND (k.dst_type IS NULL OR k.dst_type='Person')
    UNION
    SELECT k.src AS id FROM anchors k
    WHERE k.dst='6c0eeb86-bda6-5055-b3cf-81a8bf523191' AND k.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND k.arch_type='Knows'
      AND (k.src_type IS NULL OR k.src_type='Person')
  ) friends ON friends.id=member.dst
  JOIN anchors friend ON friend.id=friends.id
    AND friend.kind='NodeAnchor' AND friend.arch_type='Person'
  WHERE member.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND member.arch_type='HasMember'
    AND (member.src_type IS NULL OR member.src_type='Forum')
    AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(member.props, '$.archetype.joinDate')) AS SIGNED)>1347527525888
) memberships
JOIN anchors f ON f.id=memberships.forum_id
  AND f.kind='NodeAnchor' AND f.arch_type='Forum'
LEFT JOIN anchors co ON co.src=f.id
  AND co.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND co.arch_type='ContainerOf'
  AND (co.dst_type IS NULL OR co.dst_type='Post')
LEFT JOIN anchors p ON p.id=co.dst
  AND p.kind='NodeAnchor' AND p.arch_type='Post'
LEFT JOIN anchors hc ON hc.src=p.id
  AND hc.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND hc.arch_type='HasCreator'
  AND (hc.dst_type IS NULL OR hc.dst_type='Person')
LEFT JOIN anchors author ON author.id=hc.dst
  AND author.kind='NodeAnchor' AND author.arch_type='Person'
GROUP BY f.id, external_forum_id, title
ORDER BY post_count DESC, external_forum_id ASC
LIMIT 20

  CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.props, '$.archetype.forum_id')) AS SIGNED) AS external_forum_id,
  JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(f.props, '$.archetype.title')) AS title,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN memberships.friend_id=author.id THEN p.id END) AS post_count
FROM (
  SELECT DISTINCT member.src AS forum_id, member.dst AS friend_id
  FROM anchors member
  JOIN (
    SELECT k.dst AS id FROM anchors k
    WHERE k.src='6c0eeb86-bda6-5055-b3cf-81a8bf523191' AND k.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND k.arch_type='Knows'
      AND (k.dst_type IS NULL OR k.dst_type='Person')
    UNION
    SELECT k.src AS id FROM anchors k
    WHERE k.dst='6c0eeb86-bda6-5055-b3cf-81a8bf523191' AND k.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND k.arch_type='Knows'
      AND (k.src_type IS NULL OR k.src_type='Person')
  ) friends ON friends.id=member.dst
  JOIN anchors friend ON friend.id=friends.id
    AND friend.kind='NodeAnchor' AND friend.arch_type='Person'
  WHERE member.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND member.arch_type='HasMember'
    AND (member.src_type IS NULL OR member.src_type='Forum')
    AND CAST(JSON_UNQUOTE(JSON_EXTRACT(member.props, '$.archetype.joinDate')) AS SIGNED)>1347527525888
) memberships
JOIN anchors f ON f.id=memberships.forum_id
  AND f.kind='NodeAnchor' AND f.arch_type='Forum'
LEFT JOIN anchors co ON co.src=f.id
  AND co.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND co.arch_type='ContainerOf'
  AND (co.dst_type IS NULL OR co.dst_type='Post')
LEFT JOIN anchors p ON p.id=co.dst
  AND p.kind='NodeAnchor' AND p.arch_type='Post'
LEFT JOIN anchors hc ON hc.src=p.id
  AND hc.kind='EdgeAnchor' AND hc.arch_type='HasCreator'
  AND (hc.dst_type IS NULL OR hc.dst_type='Person')
LEFT JOIN anchors author ON author.id=hc.dst
  AND author.kind='NodeAnchor' AND author.arch_type='Person'
GROUP BY f.id, external_forum_id, title
ORDER BY post_count DESC, external_forum_id ASC
LIMIT 20
